_comments: API-key scopes for the Forms Remote Operations (#303). A ceiling on what an API key may reach, never the
authorization itself: MJ checks an operation's RequiredScope for API-key sessions only (ExecuteRemoteOperation,
before the operation runs), and each operation's Authorize() still decides for every caller.
Modelled on MJ core's domain scopes (metadata/api-scopes/.workqueue-scopes.json): a parent plus children.
The MJAPI application's ceiling must allow each child too — see ../api-application-scopes/.

fields.Name: forms
fields.Description: Parent scope for the MJ Forms Remote Operations (forms, share links, automations and responses).

fields.Name: read
fields.Description: Read Forms data through the Forms Remote Operations: response lists, response detail, response summaries and share-link claims. Resource: the operation key, e.g. Forms.ListResponses.

fields.Name: write
fields.Description: Change Forms through the Forms Remote Operations: publish, clone, create from template, archive, restore, share-link verbs and automation edits. Resource: the operation key, e.g. Forms.PublishForm.
